name: meutreino-plus
description: MeuTreino+ monorepo: mobile app, API, and shared contracts.

scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @meutreino/shared && npm run lint -w @meutreino/api && npm run lint -w @meutreino/mobile
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @meutreino/shared && npm run typecheck -w @meutreino/api && npm run typecheck -w @meutreino/mobile
scripts.test: npm run build -w @meutreino/shared && npm run test -w @meutreino/shared && npm run test -w @meutreino/api && npm run test -w @meutreino/mobile
scripts.build: npm run build -w @meutreino/shared && npm run build -w @meutreino/api && npm run build -w @meutreino/mobile
